scoring_justification: Re-inline computation of effective constants from raw stiffness tensor and direct component comparison; all quantities directly verifiable against paper gold.

outputs.description: The 6x6 effective stiffness tensor in Voigt notation. Each of the nine independent components is a floating-point number in GPa.
Effective isotropic elastic constants: Young's modulus E (GPa), shear modulus G (GPa), and Poisson's ratio ν (dimensionless).

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the stiffness matrix components and derived isotropic constants against hidden gold values from the paper using relative tolerances (hidden). The agent must implement the full homogenization procedure; the stiffness matrix step is load-bearing to ensure the computation was performed.

steps.description: Validate stiffness matrix components against paper gold with 5% relative tolerance.
Recompute effective isotropic constants (E, G, nu) from stiffness matrix and compare to paper gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference stiffness matrix and effective constants from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 and the printed stiffness matrix in Section 4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper text
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: the values are the exact numbers reported in the paper for the same composite system and method.
